goal: Create reusable Liquid Glass-styled primitives used across apps and overlays.
summary: Phase 4 completed: created a reusable Liquid Glass UI primitive library (GlassPanel, GlassButton, GlassSidebar + GlassSidebarItem, GlassToolbar, GlassPopover), added light/dark/tinted variants and a working theme toggle inside the System Settings app, and polished focus/hover/active/disabled states with smooth transitions.
